title: diff_contracts input
description: Input for `diff_contracts`. Both `base` and `head` must be `ready` snapshots; `live` is not allowed.

head.description: Snapshot id (`snap_<hex>`); must be `ready`. `live` is invalid (`invalid_argument`, `live_not_supported`).

max_hops.description: Maximum impact path depth (default 10). Paths that reach the depth limit are marked truncated.

timeout_ms.description: Cooperative timeout in milliseconds (server default: LAIN_DIFF_TIMEOUT_MS; cap: LAIN_DIFF_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS, at most 600000). Individual snapshot hydration, git diff and graph traversal operations cannot be interrupted; incomplete results are marked truncated.
